upload.hint: Maximum 8 Mo. Pour une mise à jour, téléchargez la nouvelle version du même plugin.
upload.network: Le téléchargement a échoué. Vérifiez votre connexion et essayez à nouveau.
upload.noTrusted: No certification keys configured (GCS_PLUGIN_TRUSTED_KEYS): every package is treated as not certified.

capabilities.none: Le plugin ne demande aucune capacité.

db.title: Base de données propre
db.body: Crée des tables dans un schéma séparé, avec un rôle dédié PostgreSQLTM. Il ne peut ni lire ni modifier les tableaux du site.

events.title: Événements
events.body: Apprend quand quelque chose se passe sur le site (nouveau post, nouveau membre, message de chat) et réagit en arrière-plan.

filters.title: Filtres avant l'enregistrement
filters.body: Peut changer ou rejeter les messages avant qu'ils ne soient sauvegardés.

widgets.title: Widgets
widgets.body: Ajoute des widgets que vous pouvez placer sur des pages avec -Éditer page.

pages.title: Pages du site
pages.body: A ses propres pages sur le site (adresses /p/...).

api.title: Voies API
api.body: Recevoir les demandes JSON du navigateur (adresses /api/plugins/...).

acp.title: Pages ACP
acp.body: A ses propres pages dans le panneau d'administration.

menus.title: Menus
menus.body: Ajoute des liens au menu du site ou au menu utilisateur.

jobs.title: Emploi
jobs.body: Exécute des tâches périodiques ou à la demande en arrière-plan.

settings.title: Paramètres
settings.body: A ses propres paramètres, modifiables dans les ACP.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.body: Déclare les permissions de groupe, affichées dans ACP → Groupes.

hooks.title: Points d'extension
hooks.body: Ajoute du contenu à des endroits spécifiques de l'interface (par exemple la carte d'auteur).

http-out.title: Demandes adressées à d'autres sites
http-out.body: Peut envoyer des demandes à des services externes, afin qu'il puisse envoyer les données qu'il voit. Les adresses internes sont bloquées.

client-css.title: Styles CSS
client-css.body: Apporte son propre CSS, confiné au conteneur du plugin (il ne change pas le reste du site).

client-js.title: JavaScript dans le navigateur
client-js.body: Runs JavaScript in visitors' browsers on the plugin's pages and can act on their behalf. GCS certified plugins only.

templates.title: Modèles
templates.body: Réservé : les modèles du plugin, pour le moteur du modèle.

media.title: Own media files
media.body: Receives images, videos and audio files uploaded from its pages. GCS checks them by content, re-encodes images and enforces size limits and a quota.

appearance.title: Member appearance
appearance.body: Can change how members look across the site: name style, avatar frame, banner, card background and profile extras. GCS validates everything (only colours and the plugin's own files).

rules.confirmClear: Delete the rules? The page will show an empty state and the “Rules” item leaves the menu.

general.title: General plugin (new servers)
general.lead: The same plugin for any server not added yet: it only has the site address, no key. Installed on a server, it announces itself here, under "New servers detected"; once approved it receives its key and starts sending data. By default it only collects data.

enroll.title: New servers detected
enroll.lead: Servers with the general plugin asking for a key. The site checks with a query that a real game server answers at that IP:port; the name and map are the ones reported by the server. Only approve servers you recognise.
enroll.duplicateHint: Several requests for the same IP:port: one of them may be fake.
enroll.differs: the name or map differs from the reported ones
enroll.approveUnverified: The query did not confirm a game server at this address. Approve anyway? The server will receive an API key.
enroll.approvedNew: Approved: the server was added. The plugin receives its key within a minute.
enroll.approvedAttached: Approved: attached to the chosen server. The plugin receives its key within a minute.
enroll.blockConfirm: Block the IP {ip}? Its pending requests are rejected and new ones are no longer accepted.

clans.title: Clans
clans.lead: The community clans: approving new ones, locking, archiving and disbanding, limits and each clan's log.

empty.pending: No clan is waiting for approval.

clans.rejectConfirm: Reject the clan “{name}”? The clan is deleted and the founder gets the reason.
clans.lockReason: Lock reason (optional, shown on the clan page)
clans.memberLimitHint: Empty = based on the leader's groups (ACP → Gaming → Clans → Settings → Groups).
clans.disbandText: The clan is deleted with its members, requests and images. The private forum is deleted if empty, otherwise it stays for the staff only. The log keeps the data.
clans.disbandConfirm: Disband the clan “{name}”? This cannot be undone.

settings.lead: Who creates clans and how, the tag, members, the private forum, the ranking and where the tag appears.
settings.requireApproval: A new clan waits for staff approval
settings.maxPerMember: How many clans a member can be in
settings.maxPerMemberHint: 1 = a single clan. Pending clans count too.
settings.leaveCooldownHint: How long a member who left or was removed waits before joining another clan. 0 = no pause.

charsets.alnum_symbols: Latin letters, digits and the symbols - _ . ! ? # * ~ ^ '
charsets.unicode: Letters and digits in any alphabet

settings.requestDays: Days until a join request expires
settings.archiveInactive: Automatic archiving after how many days without activity
settings.archiveInactiveHint: 0 = off; otherwise between 14 and 730 days. Activity = members active on the site or changes in the clan.
settings.officerRights: Rights the leader can give officers
settings.officerRightsHint: A right removed here also disappears from the clans that had given it.

rights.events: Register the clan for events and tournaments

settings.forumParentMissing: Choose the category for clan forums: without it no private forum can be created.

forumModes.auto: Created automatically when the clan is activated

settings.forumParentHint: An existing category (or forum). A clan forum does not inherit its permissions.
settings.forumStaff: Staff who see the private forums
settings.forumStaffHint: These groups read and post in every clan forum. The Root Admin sees them anyway.
settings.formula: Score = members' posts in the last 30 days × weight + members' reputation × weight + members active in the last 30 days × weight + members × weight. The ranking is recalculated every hour.
settings.tagPlaces: Where the tag appears next to member names
settings.profileBadge: Members get the clan badge on their profile (logo, tag and name)
settings.groupsHint: Checks and limits apply per group; a member has the combined rights of their groups. A clan's member limit comes from its leader's groups.
settings.groupsNoRight: You also need the right to edit groups to change these values.
settings.gameFormula: Added to the score only for members with stats: playtime hours × weight + K/D × 100 × weight + mix matches won × weight + average ELO ÷ 10 × weight. 0 = ignored.

bridge.title: Plugin and API keys
bridge.unsupported: The bridge (server plugin) exists only for Counter-Strike 1.6 and Counter-Strike 2.

keys.title: API keys
keys.lead: The plugin signs every request with the server key; the secret never travels over the network and is not stored in plain text. Rotating keeps the old key valid for 10 more minutes; revoking is immediate. Max 5 active keys.
keys.freshHint: Copy it into the plugin config now: it is shown only once.
keys.empty: No keys yet. Create a key for this server's plugin.
keys.label: Label
keys.rotateConfirm: Create a new key? The old one keeps working for 10 minutes.
keys.revokeConfirm: Revoke the key? The plugin using it stops immediately.

identity.title: Player identities
identity.modeHint: In mixed mode, without ReAPI / Reunion on the server, every player is non-Steam (Steam cannot be proven).
identity.cs2Hint: On CS2 every player is Steam; the mode changes nothing.
identity.nameIds: Players without a valid ID (LAN, PENDING) become name identities
identity.nameIdsHint: Name identities have low trust: anyone can use a name.

vip.title: VIP on the server
vip.lead: Members with an active VIP subscription in the enabled groups get the flags on their Steam and non-Steam identities. When it expires, the rights disappear at the next sync.
vip.flagsHint: AMXX letters (default b, the reserved slot). On CS2 they become CounterStrikeSharp permissions.

setup.title: Installing the plugin
setup.cs16: CS 1.6: AMX Mod X 1.9+ with the AmxxEasyHttp module; the gcs_bridge.amxx plugin and the gcs_bridge.cfg config (see servers-plugins/README.md).
setup.cs2: CS2: CounterStrikeSharp (on Metamod:Source); the GcsBridge plugin and its JSON config (see servers-plugins/README.md).
setup.security: Use HTTPS. The lists (admins, bans, VIP) are also kept locally on the server: a site outage stops neither admins nor bans.

package.title: Plugin for this server
package.lead: A ready-to-install archive: the compiled plugin, the config with the site address and a new API key (created now, only placed in the archive), the install note and the licence. On the server: upload the files, restart, done.
package.download: Download the plugin for this server

modules.title: Optional modules — only if you want GCS to manage the server
modules.lead: By default the plugin only collects data (statistics, matches, admins present) and changes nothing on the server: admins, bans and commands stay the server's own. Turn a module on only if you want GCS to take over that part; the plugin receives it within a minute. On the server, gcs_allow_manage 0 (CS 1.6) or "AllowManage": false (CS2) keeps them off regardless.

names.sanctions: Bans, mutes and gags from GCS

hints.admins: The admins from the ACP replace the rights from users.ini / admins.json (including name + password admins).
hints.sanctions: Sanctions given on the site are enforced on the server: banned players are kicked on join, mutes, gags.
hints.vip: VIP flags are added on top of the server's rights (the existing ones stay).
hints.mixReady: On mix servers: /ready starts the match and GCS restarts the game.
hints.commands: The gcs_ban, gcs_mute, gcs_match … commands (CS2: css_gcs…) and the admin action log.

tv.title: HLTV / GOTV and demos
tv.lead: Everything is off by default: nothing changes on the game server until you enable something here. The address adds “Watch live” to mix matches; the source brings the demo of every finished match to the match page.

watch.title: Watch live
watch.addressHint: Empty = no “Watch live” button. CS2: the GOTV port (tv_port, usually 27020).
watch.delayHintCs16: The HLTV “delay” value; shown next to the button and used to match demos.
watch.delayHintCs2: The plugin reports tv_delay; this value is only the fallback.

source.title: Mix match demos
source.label: Where the site gets the demos from

hints.ftp: The FTP account of the server (or of HLTV); the password travels unencrypted, prefer FTPS or SFTP.
hints.ftps: FTP with explicit TLS; the certificate is checked against the host name.
hints.sftp: Password or private key; the server's fingerprint is kept on the first connection.
hints.http: A web folder with a file listing (the web server's index page).
hints.plugin: The plugin records (tv_record) and uploads the demo after the match, in chunks, never during a live match.

remote.tlsInsecure: Accept an unverified certificate (insecure: anyone on the path can read the password)
remote.hostKeyHint: Empty = kept on the first connection; a changed key stops the connection.

secret.saved: Saved (not shown). Leave empty to keep it.

http.hint: E.g. https://demos.example.com/cstrike/'{file}'. The folder must list its files.

match.timeZone: Time zone of the demo names
match.timeZoneHint: HLTV writes the machine's local time in the name (e.g. Europe/Bucharest).

record.title: Recording (optional)
record.cs16: GCS starts and stops the HLTV recording through rcon
record.cs2: Record a demo of mix matches (plugin module)
record.cs16Hint: Only if HLTV does not record already: “record gcs-m…” (the match id) at live, “stoprecording” at the end, sent only to the address above (needs the HLTV adminpassword).
record.cs2Hint: The plugin runs tv_record / tv_stoprecord at match start and end (GOTV must be on: tv_enable 1). AllowManage = false keeps it off.

presets.deleteConfirm: Delete the preset “{name}”? Its admins keep their flags.

serverMaps.title: Maps
serverMaps.lead: Maps seen on the servers. Images come from your uploads or from the game's address template; without an image, the game's generic art is shown (original GCS art).

upload.title: Upload images
upload.hint: The file name gives the map name (de_dust2.jpg → de_dust2). Max 5 MB per image, max 100 files at once.
upload.saved: {count, plural, one {# image saved.} many {# images saved.} other {# images saved.}}

template.title: Address template
template.lead: Image order: the server banner, then the image uploaded here, then the address template, then the GCS art. A missing or blocked external image lets the GCS art show through.
template.settingsNote: The same settings are also under Bridge and ELO.

activeDesc.direct: Active: the visitor's browser loads the images from the template address; nothing is downloaded or stored on the site.
activeDesc.copy: Active: the worker downloads missing images every 10 minutes (guarded download, max 5 MB) and keeps them on the site.
activeDesc.none: No template: images uploaded here are shown, otherwise the GCS art.

template.previewBadMap: The sample map name isn't valid (lowercase letters, digits, _ . -).

serverMaps.empty: No maps yet: they appear when a server reports its current map.

removal.deleteHint: The account and its private data are removed. Posts can stay, signed “Deleted member”.
removal.deleteLead: What {name} has and what happens to each part. The account is blocked right after you confirm.
removal.mergeHint: Moves everything this account has into another account of the same member, then deletes this one.
removal.mergeLead: The account {name} (source) moves into the chosen account (target), then it is deleted.
removal.memberScheduled: The member asked for their account to be deleted; it is deleted on {date} unless they cancel.
removal.memberInProgress: The account is being deleted or merged and is blocked.

removal.scheduledSupersede: The member already asked for deletion (scheduled for {date}). An operation started here replaces it.
removal.hasEmpty: The account has no content or app data.

KEEP_CONTENT.title: Keep content
KEEP_CONTENT.body: Topics, posts, statuses and chat messages stay, signed “Deleted member”. Private data is erased: email, password, linked accounts, profile, private messages, notifications, IPs.

DELETE_CONTENT.title: Delete content too
DELETE_CONTENT.body: Also deletes the topics they started (with all replies), their posts, statuses, chat messages and files. Meant for spam accounts.

removal.keepMessages: Keep the private messages they sent
removal.keepMessagesHint: Deleted by default. When checked, they stay in the other members' conversations, signed “Deleted member”, without IPs.
removal.confirmLabel: Type the member's name to confirm: {name}
removal.deleteWarning: Deletion cannot be undone. The account is blocked at once; data is removed in the background.
removal.blockedSelf: You cannot delete your own account from the ACP. Use Settings → Account → “Delete account”.
removal.blockedSelfMerge: Your own account cannot be the source of a merge (it would be deleted). Swap source and target.
removal.blockedRoot: A Root Admin can only be deleted or merged by another Root Admin.

equivalents.controller: site page (routes.pages + pages in server.mjs); data from ctx.api and ctx.db
equivalents.acp_controller: ACP page (routes.acp + acp); configuration through the settings generated from the manifest
equivalents.api_controller: API route (routes.api + api), JSON, with the plugin's permissions
equivalents.model: table in the migration + access functions with ctx.db.query / ctx.db.execute
equivalents.service: functions in server.mjs (or server/*.mjs), called from pages, events and jobs
equivalents.extension: extension of a source platform class → event (events), the post.before_save filter or an extension point
equivalents.hook: hook → extension point (postbit.after_fields), widget or the post.before_save filter
equivalents.setup: install / upgrade → SQL migrations in migrations/ (the plugin's schema)
equivalents.widget: widget → widgets (sanitized HTML, rendered on the server)
equivalents.settings_form: the settings form is generated from the manifest; only special validations remain
equivalents.javascript: client JavaScript → client-js (GCS certified plugins only) or replaced with HTML/CSS
